title: oven-roasted spanish nectarines patatas bravas
description: a flavorful twist on traditional patatas bravas, featuring roasted nectarines and a spicy tomato sauce

ingredients.name: nectarines (4)
ingredients.notes: any variety, but not too ripe

ingredients.name: potatoes (2)
ingredients.notes: use red or yellow for best results

ingredients.name: olive oil (1/4
ingredients.notes: use a neutral oil for best flavor

ingredients.name: onion (1
ingredients.notes: yellow or white, whichever you prefer

ingredients.name: paprika (1
ingredients.notes: sweet or smoked, whichever you prefer

ingredients.name: tomato paste (2
ingredients.notes: canned or fresh, whichever you prefer

ingredients.name: tomato sauce (1
ingredients.notes: homemade or store-bought, whichever you prefer

ingredients.name: salt (1
ingredients.notes: use kosher or sea salt for best flavor

instructions: peel and chop the potatoes into 1-inch cubes.
toss the potatoes with 2 tbsp of olive oil, salt, and chili flakes on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
roast the potatoes in the preheated oven for 20 minutes, or until they are tender and golden brown.
while the potatoes are roasting, peel and chop the onion and garlic.
saute the onion and garlic in 1 tbsp of olive oil until the onion is translucent.
add the chili flakes, paprika, and tomato paste to the pan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
add the tomato sauce to the pan and stir to combine.
bring the sauce to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes, or until it has thickened slightly.
while the sauce is simmering, slice the nectarines into wedges.
after the potatoes have roasted for 20 minutes, add the nectarines to the baking sheet and toss to combine.
return the baking sheet to the oven and roast for an additional 5 minutes, or until the nectarines are tender and caramelized.
to serve, place the roasted potatoes and nectarines on a plate, then spoon the spicy tomato sauce over the top.
garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired
